name: Code Mode
summary: Claude writes small JavaScript programs that make many tool calls in one step.
what: In Code Mode, instead of calling tools one at a time, Claude writes a short script that runs several tool calls, such as searches, reads and edits, and returns only the result. It is experimental and off by default.

impact.title: Fewer round trips
impact.detail: Repetitive changes across many files finish in fewer steps.

impact.title: Less noise in context
impact.detail: Search output can be filtered before Claude reads it.

impact.title: Parallel commands
impact.detail: Independent commands can run at the same time.

howItWorks: Start Claude Code with CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_CODE_MODE=1, or set it in the env block of your settings.
Code steps show as Code rows; press Ctrl+O to expand them and Esc to stop one.
Add an ask rule for REPL if you want to approve each script.
Interactive terminal only, on recent Opus, Sonnet, Haiku and Fable models.
Not available through gateways or third-party cloud providers.

events.note: Code Mode arrived as an experimental opt-in.
